<thought>Based on the ESI mass spectrum, the base peak at m/z 141.1154 likely corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the proton mass gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈140.108 Da. The isotopic pattern (≈9 % M+1, ≈0.6 % M+2) matches a formula containing nine carbons, sixteen hydrogens, and one oxygen (C₉H₁₆O). This formula predicts a monoisotopic mass of 140.120 Da, which is within experimental error and fits the observed isotopic distribution.</thought>
<final_answer>C9H16O</final_answer>
